name: buoy
description: Buoy — a durable remote terminal (ssh + tmux) whose sessions resurface after network drops
//devDependencies: The app is Tauri; there is no Electron app any more. Electron is kept ONLY as a headless browser to drive the GUI tests in test/gui-*.js, which exercise the REAL ui/ frontend (the same files Tauri embeds). Nothing in ui/ or src-tauri/ requires it, and `npm test` does not need it.
